restaurant_name: Topstar Clinic ท็อปสตาร์ คลินิก ความงาม เชียงใหม่
text:
I went for a Botox Nabota injection in my underarms (100 units) for 2,990 THB. The first thing I was asked to sign was a waiver stating that I would not sue the clinic, either civilly or criminally, for any unforeseen complications from the procedure. That was my first shock.

The package I booked included free fat dissolving treatment, but I asked to switch it to leg laser hair removal. The admin replied, “You can come back to the clinic to check on the day of the procedure.” 🥰🥰 Why would they say “it’s possible” or “it’s not possible”?

On the day of the procedure, the staff seemed confused about who said that. In the end, I got the procedure done. However, I still have some hair left from previous treatments, but the staff said there was no hair left. During the actual procedure, they didn't even do a full leg laser treatment; some hair remained, as if they were stingy with the shots. They then suggested IPL instead. IPL isn't a laser hair removal; the clinic should learn something new. Of course, the hair didn't fall out because they probably used the lowest setting.

My second shock: For the underarm Botox, the doctor just injected a few times and it was over in less than 5 minutes. It was a very sloppy job, as you can see from the needle marks in the picture. Clearly, the medication was already mixed, and there was no pre- or post-treatment explanation whatsoever. There was no numbing cream applied; even ice packs didn't numb the area before they started the injection. I don't know what they injected, or if it was even 50 units of Botox.

Three weeks have passed, and there's been no result whatsoever. I still sweat just as much as before; it hasn't decreased at all. I'm not usually someone who sweats excessively, but there should have been some change by now.

I've noticed that all the reviews here are from clinic employees, as each account only has one review, which is for this clinic. If even simple procedures are done so haphazardly, I don't even want to think about surgery.
